shellCommands.command: cat /workspace/package.json; echo "---GITIGNORE---"; cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "---EVAL---"; ls -la /workspace/__agent_eval__; echo "---NODE---"; node --version; npm --version

rm -rf /tmp/smoke && BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3111 node src/main.js > /tmp/smoke.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1.2
cd /workspace
echo "=== home (empty) ==="; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -oE 'Nothing on the go[^<]*|No finished books yet[^<]*'
echo "=== add two books ==="
LOC1=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' -X POST localhost:3111/books --data-urlencode 'title=The Dispossessed' --data-urlencode 'author=Ursula K. Le Guin' --data-urlencode 'notes=Anarres vs Urras.
Second line of notes.')
LOC2=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' -X POST localhost:3111/books --data-urlencode 'title=Piranesi' --data-urlencode 'author=Susanna Clarke')
echo "book1 -> $LOC1"; echo "book2 -> $LOC2"
ID2=$(basename "$LOC2")
echo "=== mark Piranesi finished ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'status=%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n' -X POST "localhost:3111/books/$ID2/status" -d 'status=finished'
echo "=== home now ==="; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -oE 'row-title[^>]*>[^<]+|row-meta">[^<]+'
echo "=== shared link to book1 (fresh request, no session) ==="
curl -s "$LOC1" | grep -oE '<h1>[^<]+|class="author">[^<]+|Anarres[^<]*|Second line[^<]*|http://[^"]*books/[^"]*'
echo "=== persisted file ==="; cat /tmp/smoke/books.json

cd /workspace
echo "=== restart, same data file ==="
pkill -f "node src/main.js"; sleep 0.5
BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3112 node src/main.js > /tmp/smoke2.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1.2
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'shared link after restart: %{http_code}\n' localhost:3112/books/e4e4fb33-7cbb-456a-9c32-0b3c5c4b564a
curl -s localhost:3112 | grep -cE 'row-title' | xargs echo "books on home page:"
echo "=== oversized body log line ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '413 check: %{http_code}\n' -X POST localhost:3112/books --data "title=$(head -c 70000 /dev/zero | tr '\0' 'x')"
sleep 0.3; grep -c 'at readForm' /tmp/smoke2.log | xargs echo "stack traces logged (want 0):"; grep 'books' /tmp/smoke2.log | tail -2
pkill -f "node src/main.js"; echo done

cd /workspace
BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3113 node src/main.js > /tmp/smoke2.log 2>&1 &
PID=$!
sleep 1.2
echo "=== after restart, same data file ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'shared link still resolves: %{http_code}\n' localhost:3113/books/e4e4fb33-7cbb-456a-9c32-0b3c5c4b564a
curl -s localhost:3113 | grep -cE 'row-title' | xargs echo "books listed on home:"
BIG=$(head -c 70000 /dev/zero | tr '\0' 'x')
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'oversized POST: %{http_code}\n' -X POST localhost:3113/books --data "title=$BIG"
sleep 0.4
echo "--- server log ---"; cat /tmp/smoke2.log
kill $PID; echo "(server stopped)"

printf 'node_modules/
__agent_eval__/
data/
' > .gitignore && cat .gitignore && echo "--- tests ---" && npm test 2>&1 | tail -12
which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome firefox 2>/dev/null; ls /root/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; echo "exit: none found"

cd /workspace
BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3114 node src/main.js > /dev/null 2>&1 &
PID=$!; sleep 1.1
curl -s localhost:3114/books/04f68b7d-1d88-4a62-bbe3-074312ab57af | sed -n '/<body>/,/<\/body>/p'
kill $PID
